notes.title: Max Gentlemen Sexy Business! Released
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'm super excited to announce our next game in the Max Gentlemen Universe has launched right here on Steam! Check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/817840/Max_Gentlemen_Sexy_Business/

If you were a fan of the absurdist nature of Max Gentlemen then you are sure to love Sexy Business! It's a much [i]larger [/i]and [b]bolder[/b] game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6640009/1433104d3b661416276046095aa6806687a8637b.png[/img]

notes.title: 50% off launch sale, King Pack & Trading Cards
notes.content:
The King pack is out! We made 5 new characters based on our biggest fans and added 10 new royal themed hats for your stacking pleasure. As well, we added Trading Cards.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/71780/]Get all 3 DLCs 50% off[/url] for a limited time!
